description: This file defines a React component for a modal that displays trial benefits information in the Mattermost application. It includes UI elements, hooks, and logic for rendering different steps and content based on trial status and license info.

methods.name: TrialBenefitsModal
methods.description: React functional component rendering a modal with trial benefits information, including steps, content for trial start, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Determines and renders the modal content based on whether the trial just started or not.

methods.name: trialJustStartedScreen
methods.description: Renders the UI for the initial trial start screen with options to close or invite people.

methods.name: handleOnClose
methods.description: Handles closing the modal, calling onClose and onExited callbacks.

methods.name: invitePeople
methods.description: Opens the invite people modal and closes the current modal.

methods.name: getSlides
methods.description: Generates slide components for the carousel based on defined steps.
